text:
alex: quick follow-up from yesterday's perf incident — want to lock remediation owners and a short timeline. proposal: 1) prioritize user-facing latency items in the remediation queue, 2) owners + due dates on each ticket, 3) add dashboard panels (p95/p99 by model family and seq-length histogram), 4) consider temporary SLO relaxation only if we can auto-unwind in 2w. thoughts?
maria: +1 on prioritization. i can take the kv-cache regen item (INF-4123). aiming EOW for the patch and test. :thumbsup:
sam: cautious about SLO relax. prefer progressive throttling on low-priority routes instead of touching SLOs. can prototype throttling config today.
tara: dashboard histograms are useful — will add seq-length distribution panel and link to runbook. can have a draft panel by tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: ticket INF-4123 created (kv-cache regen) — owner: maria, due: 2026-03-27.
alex: thanks — assigning sam to throttling spike (INF-4124) and tara to dashboard panels (INF-4125). scheduling 10:00am sync tomorrow to confirm.
maria: ACK, will update INF-4123 with validation plan.
sam: ACK, will open PR with throttling config. quick snippet i’ll test:```
routes:
  /embed:
    priority: low
    throttle: 0.5
```
(we'll tune)
tara: will add p95/p99-by-model and seq-length histogram; linking alerts to the SLO runbook.
alex: i'll update the postmortem with owners + timeline and draft a short RFC proposing a temporary SLO shift only if throttling proves insufficient. please flag objections in 24h.
maria: no objections.
sam: +1.
ops-bot: reminder set for 2026-03-24 10:00:00 for "SLO remediations sync".
